notes.title: Demo is Live!
notes.content: [p]Very excited to announce that our Leaks in Space Demo is now live on steam! [/p][p][i]This is a [b]Pre-Alpha Demo[/b]. It is limited to a single sector and represents only a small portion of the planned game. The project is still in active development, and the final game may differ significantly from what you see here.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]What to expect in the Demo: (if everything goes well)[/h3][list][*][p]Ship Building[/p][/*][*][p]Combat System[/p][/*][*][p]3 Different types of threats[/p][/*][*][p]A part of the space to explore[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you want to chat more about the game (or just hang out with us), come join our Discord! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/NYzttUTDxM" style="button" buttoncolor="#ae1937"]Join Our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Try Leaks in Space Demo here:[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583820/Leaks_In_Space_Demo?snr=1_2108_9_2107"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
